# Zoopla UK Property Listings and Lease Details Scraper

Zoopla is one of the UK's two largest property portals alongside Rightmove. This actor turns a Zoopla search page or a list of direct listing URLs into structured property records — price, rooms, address and coordinates, plus lease, EPC and council-tax detail that most basic property scrapers skip.

## What this actor does

- Accepts Zoopla search URLs (e.g. `/for-sale/property/london/`, `/to-rent/property/manchester/`) and scrapes every listing shown on that results page
- Also accepts direct listing URLs (`/for-sale/details/<id>/` or `/to-rent/details/<id>/`) and fetches each one individually
- Captures leasehold specifics — ground rent, service charge and lease expiry — alongside tenure and EPC rating when the listing discloses them
- Covers both for-sale and to-rent listings, including new-home development names and shared-ownership flags where applicable
- Omits any field the listing didn't disclose — no empty strings or nulls in the output
- If every attempt is blocked, the run still finishes with a single status record explaining why, instead of failing with no output

## Output per listing

- `type: "zoopla_listing"`
- `id`, `url`, `title`
- `price`, `priceCurrency`, `priceLabel` — numeric price, currency code, and the price text as displayed (e.g. "£550,000", "£1,800 pcm", "Guide price £420,000")
- `bedrooms`, `bathrooms`, `receptionRooms`
- `propertyType` — e.g. Flat, Terraced, Detached, Bungalow
- `tenure` — Freehold, Leasehold, etc.
- `address`, `postcode`
- `latitude`, `longitude`
- `images[]` — hero and gallery image URLs
- `agent`, `agentPhone`
- `descriptionText`
- `features[]` — key-feature bullet points
- `listingType`, `listingStatus`
- `furnishedStatus` — for rental listings, when stated
- `councilTaxBand`
- `epcRating`, `epcScore` — energy performance rating and numeric score, when published
- `leaseExpiry`, `groundRent`, `serviceCharge` — leasehold detail, when the listing is leasehold
- `isSharedOwnership` — only present when true
- `newHomesDevName` — development name, for new-build listings
- `floorPlanUrls[]`, `virtualTourUrl`
- `publishedAt`, `lastModified`
- `scrapedAt`

If every attempt for a run is blocked, the dataset contains a single record of `type: "zoopla_blocked"` instead.

## Input

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `searchUrls` | array | `["https://www.zoopla.co.uk/for-sale/property/london/"]` | Zoopla search URLs or direct listing URLs |
| `maxItems` | integer | `3` | Maximum number of listings to return (1–500) |
| `proxyConfiguration` | object | Apify RESIDENTIAL (GB) | Required proxy configuration; Zoopla blocks non-residential IPs at the network edge |

### Example: for-sale listings in a city

```json
{
  "searchUrls": ["https://www.zoopla.co.uk/for-sale/property/manchester/"],
  "maxItems": 20
}
```

### Example: rentals in an area

```json
{
  "searchUrls": ["https://www.zoopla.co.uk/to-rent/property/bristol/"],
  "maxItems": 15
}
```

### Example: specific listing URLs

```json
{
  "searchUrls": [
    "https://www.zoopla.co.uk/for-sale/details/65123456/"
  ],
  "maxItems": 1
}
```

## Use cases

- **Home buyers** compare EPC ratings, council tax bands and lease terms across a shortlist before viewing
- **Letting agents and landlords** track asking rents and furnished status across a local area
- **Leasehold due diligence** pull ground rent and service charge figures before an offer
- **Market research** monitor price and property-type mix for a city or postcode area
- **PropTech and valuation tools** feed live Zoopla asking prices and coordinates into a comparables model

## FAQ

**Is this affiliated with Zoopla?**
No. This is an independent actor that reads publicly available Zoopla listing pages; it is not operated by or affiliated with Zoopla.

**Does it work for rentals as well as sales?**
Yes — any `/to-rent/property/<area>/` search URL or `/to-rent/details/<id>/` listing URL works the same way as the for-sale equivalents.

**Can it pull sold-price history?**
No — the actor extracts the current listing's own data; historical sold-price timelines aren't part of the output.

**Why did I get fewer listings than `maxItems` from one search URL?**
Each search URL only supplies the listings shown on that one results page (Zoopla typically shows around 25 per page). Supply several search URLs (e.g. different areas, or the same area with Zoopla's own filters applied) or a list of direct listing URLs to collect more.

**Why do I sometimes get a single `zoopla_blocked` record instead of listings?**
That happens only when every attempt for the run was blocked. Re-running shortly afterward, or supplying a direct listing URL instead of a search URL, usually succeeds.

**Why are `epcRating`, `leaseExpiry` or `councilTaxBand` sometimes missing?**
Those fields only appear when the individual listing discloses them; Zoopla doesn't require every seller or agent to publish them.

**Do I need to configure the proxy myself?**
No — the required proxy configuration is pre-set to Apify's residential GB pool, which Zoopla requires to avoid being blocked at the network edge.

**Is login required?**
No — all Zoopla listing and search pages used by this actor are publicly accessible.
